sources: Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 (No. 22 of 2023)
disclaimer: Engineering mapping for developer guidance; not legal advice.

rules.title: Personal data written to logs in clear text
rules.obligation: Data Fiduciary must protect personal data in its possession by taking reasonable security safeguards to prevent a personal data breach.
rules.rules_ref: Rule 6 (reasonable security safeguards: masking, encryption, access control, logging hygiene)

rules.title: Unredacted personal data sent to a third-party LLM / external API
rules.obligation: Processing by a Data Processor only under a valid contract; reasonable safeguards must prevent disclosure beyond the stated purpose.

rules.title: Personal data table without retention / erasure logic
rules.obligation: Erase personal data once the purpose is no longer served or consent is withdrawn, unless retention is required by law.

rules.title: Pre-checked / bundled consent (dark pattern)
rules.obligation: Consent must be free, specific, informed, unconditional and unambiguous with a clear affirmative action.

rules.title: Personal data collected without notice / purpose statement
rules.obligation: Every request for consent must be accompanied by a notice describing the personal data and the purpose of processing.

rules.title: Hard-coded personal data or secret in source
rules.obligation: Reasonable security safeguards; personal data and credentials must not be embedded in source code.

rules.title: Child data processed without verifiable parental consent
rules.obligation: Obtain verifiable consent of the parent before processing personal data of a child; no tracking or targeted advertising.
